description: Rutas - Creación Masiva: 6-step wizard for bulk route creation during institution onboarding with Google Maps optimization

userStories.title: Create bulk route wizard page structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the page structure and navigation for the 6-step bulk route creation wizard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create page at apps/admin/src/app/(dashboard)/routes/bulk-create/page.tsx
Create BulkRouteWizard component at apps/admin/src/components/routes/bulk-wizard/BulkRouteWizard.tsx with step state (1-6)
Create WizardStepIndicator component showing current step and progress
Add Siguiente (next) and Atrás (back) navigation buttons
Add link from routes list page: button 'Creación Masiva' linking to /routes/bulk-create
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 1 - Route type and schedule selection
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to define the basic parameters for the routes I'm creating.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step1BasicInfo component in bulk-wizard folder
Radio buttons for route type: Recogida (casa→colegio) or Entrega (colegio→casa)
Time picker for target time (arrival for pickup, departure for dropoff)
Radio buttons for operation days: Diario or Días específicos
Checkbox group for days of week when Días específicos selected
Form validation: type and time are required
Store selections in wizard state via props/callbacks
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 1 - Fleet and student summary display
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see a summary of available resources before proceeding.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Convex query getOnboardingStats(institutionId, routeType) returning vehicle/driver/monitor/student counts
Query active vehicles, active drivers with valid licenses, active monitors
Query students without route assignment for selected type
Display summary cards in Step1BasicInfo: X vehículos, Y conductores, Z monitores, W estudiantes sin ruta
Disable Siguiente button if no students without routes available
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Split view layout with map
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need a split view with map on left and student panel on right.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step2StudentSelection component with 50/50 split layout (flex or grid)
Left side: InteractiveMap or GoogleRouteMap showing school marker
Right side: Panel with route summary header and student list area below
Route summary shows: type, target time, operation days from Step 1
Counter showing X de Y estudiantes seleccionados
Use responsive layout: stack vertically on mobile (md breakpoint)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Student list with pagination
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see available students in a paginated list.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Convex query getUnassignedStudents(institutionId, routeType, filters, page, limit)
Display 20 students per page with pagination controls (prev/next, page number)
Each student row shows: name, grade, abbreviated address (first 30 chars), GPS indicator
GPS indicator: green checkmark if homeLatitude/homeLongitude exist, red X if missing
Default filter: only students with GPS coordinates (hasGps: true)
Loading skeleton while fetching
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Student filters and search
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to filter and search students to find specific groups.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input filtering by student name with 300ms debounce
Dropdown filter by grade/year (populated from institution grades)
Dropdown filter by parent/guardian (from students.parentId)
Toggle filter Solo con ubicación GPS (default: on)
Filters combine with AND logic
Reset filters button clears all filters
Pagination resets to page 1 when any filter changes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Student selection functionality
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to select students for route assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkbox on each student row for individual selection
Seleccionar página button selects all visible students on current page
Seleccionar todos button selects all filtered students across all pages
Limpiar selección button deselects all selected students
Selected students have highlighted background (bg-primary/10 or similar)
Selection count updates in header counter in real-time
Selected student IDs stored in wizard state array
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Map visualization of selected students
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see selected students appear on the map.
acceptanceCriteria: School marker always visible using institution coordinates
When student selected, blue marker appears at homeLatitude/homeLongitude
When student deselected, marker disappears from map
All student markers use same blue color in this step
Click marker shows student name in InfoWindow popup
Map auto-fits bounds to show all markers plus school when selection changes
Map supports zoom and pan interaction
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 2 - Selection validation and confirmation
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to validate and confirm my student selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Warning banner (yellow Alert) if any selected students lack GPS coordinates
Display total selected count prominently before Confirmar Estudiantes button
Confirmar Estudiantes button disabled if selectedStudents.length === 0
Atrás button returns to Step 1 preserving Step 1 form data
Confirmar Estudiantes proceeds to Step 3 with selected student IDs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 3 - Layout and vehicle list display
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see selected students summary and available vehicles.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step3VehicleCalculation component
Header showing X estudiantes seleccionados para asignar a rutas
List active vehicles with valid documents from Convex query
Each vehicle row shows: plate, brand/model, capacity, status badge
Checkbox on each vehicle to include in calculation
Running total: Capacidad seleccionada: X / Y estudiantes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 3 - Capacity validation and parameters
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need capacity feedback and optional calculation parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: Warning banner (yellow) when total vehicle capacity < selected students
Success indicator (green checkmark) when capacity >= students
Collapsible Parámetros Avanzados section (default collapsed)
Number input: Radio de agrupación (default 100m, min 50, max 500)
Number input: Tiempo máximo de ruta (default 60 min, min 30, max 120)
Radio: Priorizar: Menos paradas vs Menor distancia total
Store all parameters in wizard state
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Route clustering algorithm service
userStories.description: As a system, I need to cluster students into route groups by proximity.
acceptanceCriteria: Create clusterStudentsForRoutes function in apps/admin/src/services/routeClustering.ts
Input: students with coordinates, vehicle capacities, school location, groupingRadius
Use k-means or distance-based clustering to group students
Number of clusters = number of vehicles selected
Students within groupingRadius share a stop (use first student location)
Balance student count across clusters respecting capacity
Return: array of { vehicleId, students[], stops[] } objects
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Google Maps route optimization integration
userStories.description: As a system, I need to optimize stop order using Google Directions API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create optimizeRouteOrder function in apps/admin/src/services/routeOptimization.ts
Use existing packages/maps directions service or create wrapper
Call Directions API with waypoints and optimize:true
For pickup: origin=first stop, destination=school
For dropoff: origin=school, destination=last stop
Return: optimized stop order, encoded polyline, total duration, total distance
Handle API errors: return original order with error flag
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 3 - Calculate routes button and flow
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to trigger route calculation and see progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Calcular Rutas button disabled until at least one vehicle selected
Button shows loading spinner during calculation
Progress text: Calculando rutas... (puede tomar unos segundos)
Call clustering service then optimization service for each cluster
On success: store generated routes in wizard state, proceed to Step 4
On error (insufficient capacity): show error with unassigned count
On API error: show retry button with error message
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 4 - Split view with route cards
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see generated routes in card format with map.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step4ReviewRoutes component with split layout
Left: Google Map (empty initially)
Right: Summary header + scrollable list of route cards
Summary: X rutas generadas, Y estudiantes asignados, Z sin asignar
Warning banner if unassigned students > 0
Route cards show: auto-name, vehicle plate, stops count, students count, time, distance
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented Step4RouteReview.tsx with split view (1/3 route cards, 2/3 map)

userStories.title: Step 4 - Route card selection and map toggle
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to toggle route visibility on the map.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkbox on each route card to toggle map visibility
Seleccionar todas button checks all route cards
Deseleccionar todas button unchecks all route cards
Ver Detalle button on each card (functionality in later story)
Auto-generate route names: Ruta Recogida 1, Ruta Entrega 2, etc.
Editable route name field on card (inline edit)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented map visibility checkbox, bulk select/deselect buttons, auto-generated route names, and inline editable name field

userStories.title: Step 4 - Multi-route map visualization
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see selected routes on map with distinct colors.
acceptanceCriteria: Define color palette array (8-10 distinct colors) for routes
Each selected route draws polyline in its assigned color
Stop markers shown in route color with order number label
School marker always visible (distinct icon)
Click stop marker shows InfoWindow with student names
Click polyline shows route name in InfoWindow
Map auto-fits bounds to show all selected routes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented MultiRouteMap component with 10-color palette, polylines, stop markers with order labels, school marker with building icon, InfoWindows for stops and polylines, and auto bounds fitting

userStories.title: Step 4 - Route detail modal
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to view individual route details in a modal.
acceptanceCriteria: Ver Detalle button opens modal/Dialog component
Modal shows dedicated map with single route polyline
List of stops in order with students assigned to each stop
Editable route name input field at top
Vehicle selector dropdown (from selected vehicles in Step 3)
Guardar Cambios and Descartar buttons at bottom
Modal is scrollable for long stop lists
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: RouteDetailModal integrated with Step4RouteReview. Ver Detalle button opens modal, map placeholder ready for US-017 polyline rendering.

userStories.title: Step 4 - Stop reordering with drag and drop
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to manually adjust stop order in route detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Stops list supports drag-and-drop reordering (use @dnd-kit or similar)
Drag handle icon on each stop row
Map polyline updates in real-time when order changes
After reorder: recalculate route by calling Directions API
Show loading indicator during recalculation
Update time and distance display with new values
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented with native HTML5 drag-and-drop instead of @dnd-kit. Uses recalculateRouteWithFixedOrder from routeOptimization.ts service.

userStories.title: Step 4 - Modify stops and students in detail
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to add/remove stops and reassign students.
acceptanceCriteria: Eliminar parada button on each stop (moves students to unassigned)
Confirmation dialog before deleting stop
Agregar estudiante dropdown on each stop (from unassigned list)
Nueva parada button creates stop with selected unassigned student location
Route stats (stops, students, time, distance) update after modifications
Polyline recalculates after adding/removing stops
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in RouteDetailModal.tsx with delete confirmation, add student dropdown, new stop creation, stats update via useMemo

userStories.title: Step 4 - Unassigned students panel
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see and handle unassigned students.
acceptanceCriteria: Collapsible panel/accordion showing unassigned students if count > 0
Panel header shows count: X estudiantes sin asignar
Each unassigned student shows name and home address
Asignar button opens dropdown to select route and stop
After assignment student moves to selected route/stop
Unassigned count in summary header updates
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented UnassignedStudentsPanel and UnassignedStudentRow components with collapsible accordion UI and route/stop assignment dropdown

userStories.title: Step 4 - Validation warnings and navigation
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need warnings about issues before confirming routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Warning banner if any route exceeds max time parameter from Step 3
Warning banner if any route has only 1 student (ineficiente)
Warning banner if unassigned students remain
Warnings are yellow Alert components, not blocking
Confirmar Rutas button proceeds to Step 5
Atrás button returns to Step 3 (clears generated routes, keeps selections)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Step 5 - Driver assignment interface
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to assign drivers to each confirmed route.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step5CrewAssignment component
List confirmed routes with driver Select dropdown on each
Driver options show: name, license expiry, already-assigned warning
Query active drivers with valid licenses for dropdown
Warning icon if driver already assigned to another route at same schedule
Warning banner if any route has no driver (blocks proceeding)
Store driver assignments in wizard state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Step5Assignment.tsx implements driver assignment with license expiry display, prevents double-assignment

userStories.title: Step 5 - Monitor assignment and summary
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to optionally assign monitors and see summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Monitor Select dropdown on each route (optional, includes Sin monitor option)
Query active monitors for dropdown options
Warning icon if monitor already assigned to another route at same time
Summary section below assignments showing all counts
Summary: rutas, estudiantes, paradas, vehículos, conductores, monitores
Siguiente button enabled only when all routes have drivers
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Step5Assignment.tsx updated with monitor conflict detection and summary section

userStories.title: Step 6 - Final review display
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need to see everything before creating routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Step6Confirmation component
Display all routes in compact card grid (2-3 columns)
Each card shows: name, vehicle, driver, monitor, stops count, students count
Recurrence reminder: Días de operación: Lunes, Martes... or Diario
Crear Rutas button prominently styled (primary, large)
Atrás button returns to Step 5
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Step6Confirmation.tsx already implemented with card grid, recurrence display, primary-styled Crear Rutas button

userStories.title: Bulk route creation Convex mutation
userStories.description: As a system, I need to save all routes in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Create createBulkRoutes mutation in convex/routes.ts
Input: institutionId, userId, routes[] with stops and studentIds
For each route: reuse createRouteWithStops internal logic
Set recurrence from wizard configuration on each route
Return: { success, routesCreated, studentsAssigned, errors[] }
Handle partial failures: continue creating remaining routes, collect errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Already implemented in commit 6f8b1a0. Mutation creates routes, routeStops, and studentRoutes with partial failure handling.

userStories.title: Step 6 - Save progress and success feedback
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need feedback during and after saving routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Crear Rutas button shows spinner and disables during save
Progress text: Creando rutas... X de Y
Call createBulkRoutes mutation with all wizard data
On success: show success Alert with count of routes created
Show buttons: Ver Rutas (navigate to /routes) and Crear Más (reset wizard)
On partial failure: show warning with failed routes list, option to proceed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in Step6Confirmation.tsx with loading state (Loader2 spinner), progress indicator, success/error/partial_success states, and Ver Rutas/Crear Mas buttons

userStories.title: Optional trip generation after route creation
userStories.description: As a system, I need to optionally generate initial trips for new routes.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful route creation, show prompt dialog
Prompt: ¿Generar viajes para los próximos 7 días?
Sí button: call createTrip for each route for next 7 days
Use existing createTrip mutation from trips.ts
Show count of trips generated in final success message
No button: skip trip generation, show success without trips
Handle trip generation errors separately, don't fail the whole flow
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in Step6Confirmation.tsx with prompt_trips and generating_trips states
